facts.cheats: Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep them off your platinum save.
facts.saves: 15 manual save slots and 1 autosave. No mission replay: keep a save at the start and end of each chapter (10 saves), then rotate the remaining 5 for free-roam clean-up.

source: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap and GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist & Guide

stages.text: Play the story and enjoy it. Do optional missions as they appear — purple icons and black icons with pink letters — because they introduce robberies, fishing, hunting and the other systems, and you need 100 optional tasks for the checklist later. Scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study animals through the binoculars as you go: the checklist wants 200 of 277 base vehicles and 100 of 255 animals, and progress made during the story already counts even though the checklist itself only becomes visible after the story. One warning: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house — PowerPyx flags it as the only possibly missable trophy moment in the game.
stages.title: Finish the story, do optional missions as they appear

stages.text: After the ending, the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, and most collectibles only partly. The only tasks that demand everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's hunting quests. You need any 70 of the 80 challenges, so skip the hardest ten. Everything on this list is still doable in free-roam — nothing is missable.
stages.title: 100% Completion checklist and 70 of 80 challenges

stages.text: The Strangers & Freaks strands are not needed for 100%, so they are usually what is left, together with any stray trophies that did not pop on their own. Finish the 8 counting strands, the five character questlines, and the last miscellaneous trophies — then the platinum pops.
stages.title: Strangers & Freaks and miscellaneous clean-up
